sources.locator: Tensat e-graphs, DAG-cost definition and the faster-greedy-dag reference extractor (proxy for Magellan's private e-graphs)

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

notes: Magellan's LLVM experiments use Google's internal search application, and its XLA e-graphs and cost model are not released; the IOPDDL contest benchmarks, including the 20 withheld during the contest, are public in github.com/google/iopddl. LLVM/contest specification links are dependencies, not a released Magellan implementation.

limitations: No official public runnable implementation verified from the inspected paper. External benchmark code may exist separately.
